_comment: Bull (DeepSperm) cross-species transfer split manifest. The DeepSperm benchmark (340 annotated frames) is partitioned, mirroring the human source-domain train/val/test discipline, into three disjoint splits: a 100-frame fine-tuning pool (with nested 20- and 50-frame subsets), a 20-frame validation split used for few-shot early stopping and for configuring the classical baseline, and a 220-frame held-out test split. ALL cross-species transfer metrics reported in the paper (zero-shot and few-shot) are computed on the 220-frame held-out test split, which is disjoint from every fine-tuning pool and from the validation split (verified at frame-file level: train pool cap test = 0, train pool cap val = 0). The split is random at frame level; DeepSperm contains 39 groups of pixel-identical images, and 22 test frames have an identical copy in the pool or validation split (excluding them changes fine-tuned mAP50 by -0.001 to +0.015; see README). Per-split SHA-256 hashes are of the image-list .txt files. Absolute machine paths are redacted to placeholders.

zeroshot_full.role: full DeepSperm set (340 frames); not used directly for reported metrics

fewshot_train_100.role: few-shot fine-tuning pool (nested superset of train_50 and train_20)

fewshot_train_50.role: few-shot fine-tuning pool (50 frames; subset of train_100)

fewshot_train_20.role: few-shot fine-tuning pool (20 frames; subset of train_50)

fewshot_val.role: validation split for few-shot early stopping only; not used for reported metrics

fewshot_test.role: held-out test split; ALL reported bull transfer metrics (zero-shot and few-shot) are computed here

fewshot_train_20_sub101.role: alternative 20-frame fine-tuning subset for subset-selection variance analysis

fewshot_train_20_sub202.role: alternative 20-frame fine-tuning subset for subset-selection variance analysis

fewshot_train_20_sub303.role: alternative 20-frame fine-tuning subset for subset-selection variance analysis
